patterns_found.name: Change of Character
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish lower highs and lower lows to bullish structure. Price established a higher low near 1775 after the 1725 swing low, then broke above prior swing high resistance around 1800-1825.

patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three distinct lows visible: left shoulder near 1775, head near 1725, and right shoulder near 1775-1800. Price has moved above the neckline area around 1800-1825.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Sharp upward impulse from roughly 1775 to 1840 followed by consolidation near highs between approximately 1810 and 1840.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price reversed from the 1725 low, established a higher low near 1775, and rallied to approximately 1840. Current price action is consolidating near highs around 1830-1840.
